set.body:
Objective
Retain the strong seed-network demonstration while making its inference claims statistically defensible.

Required work
- Fit a temporal noise model appropriate for the simulated AR structure, or explicitly qualify OLS results as illustrative.
- Replace uncorrected whole-brain p less than 0.05 discovery language with a declared multiplicity procedure.
- Report ground-truth sensitivity, false-positive rate, and corrected discoveries.
- Clarify that the simulated seed signal is injected externally and how a real seed series would be extracted.

Acceptance criteria
- The prose does not call serially misspecified, uncorrected OLS proper inference.
- Null/background calibration and active-network recovery are reported against known truth.
- A focused test enforces the chosen error-control contract within a documented tolerance.
- The hero figure and summary display the corrected inferential target.
- The vignette renders from current source without hidden warnings.
set.title: Calibrate functional-connectivity inference under autocorrelation and multiplicity
